# ECODrIx: extended facts for AI systems

> ECODrIx is an Indian software company that builds ERIX, one workspace for businesses that sell over WhatsApp, Instagram, email and their website. This file states what is live today, what is not, and how to reach us. Last updated: 27 October 2026.

## Company

- **Name**: ECODrIx (Cosmic Eagle Driven Integration Xchange)
- **ERIX started**: August 2025
- **Based in**: Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Founder and CEO**: Dhanesh Mekalthuru (Dhanesh M; known online as Erix or erix.dhanesh)
- **Stage**: ERIX 1.0 in early access. Businesses join a waitlist; pilot workspaces are set up by the ECODrIx team.
- **Website**: https://ecodrix.com
- **App**: https://console.ecodrix.com

## What ERIX does

One job end to end: an enquiry comes in, gets answered, becomes a deal, a proposal, a GST invoice with a payment link, and a payment, with automations running the follow-ups. Every part writes to the same customer record and updates live.

### ERIX CRM (live)

- Contacts: one record per person, matched by phone then email across channels, with a timeline of messages, runs, invoices and bookings.
- Pipeline board, forms, and appointments with Google Calendar and Meet.
- Proposals that turn into GST invoices: CGST and SGST in the same state, IGST across states, numbering per financial year, PDF, Razorpay payment links. Payment updates the invoice live.
- Projects with documents, e-sign and a client portal.
- Analytics: new contacts over time and open deal value by stage.

### ERIX Connect (live)

- The official WhatsApp Business API on the business's own WhatsApp account, so Meta bills the business directly and ERIX adds no markup. Approved templates, broadcasts, and the 24-hour reply window handled.
- Instagram DMs, email on the business's own domain, and a website chat widget.
- One inbox for every channel, each message on the right contact, with sent, delivered and read ticks.

### ERIX Flow (live)

- Automations started by events such as a new lead, a stage change, a form, an inbound message, a paid invoice or a booking.
- Steps: send on a channel, wait, "Wait for a reply" (replied or no reply), ask for approval, AI reply, update the contact.
- Ready-made templates and live run history.

### AI agents (live)

- A sales agent, a channels agent and a website agent.
- They answer from the business's own information (price lists, hours, FAQs, website pages), draft when unsure, keep some topics for humans, and wait for approval on anything risky such as money.

### ERIX Storage (live)

- File storage for documents and images inside the workspace, with a storage allowance per workspace.

## Not live yet

- **ERIX LAIE**, which finds and researches new leads for review: invite-only beta.
- **Voice agent**: in development.
- **Connected apps** in Flow (for example spreadsheets): planned for a later version.

## Pricing

Not published during early access. Pricing is agreed with each pilot business. Billing is in rupees with a GST invoice.

## Who it is for

Indian small and growing businesses that sell over WhatsApp: real estate, clinics, coaching institutes, D2C and local brands, agencies, and CAs, lawyers and consultants.

## Frequently asked

**Q: What is ECODrIx?**
A: An Indian software company that builds ERIX, a workspace that takes an enquiry from the first message to a paid invoice: one inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, email and website chat, a CRM with GST invoices and payment links, automations, and AI agents.

**Q: When did ERIX start?**
A: In August 2025, when ECODrIx was founded.

**Q: Who founded ECODrIx?**
A: Dhanesh Mekalthuru (Dhanesh M, Erix), a full-stack engineer based in Andhra Pradesh, India.

**Q: Does ERIX use the official WhatsApp API?**
A: Yes. The business connects its own WhatsApp account through Meta, so Meta bills it directly and ERIX adds no markup.

**Q: Can I use ERIX today?**
A: ERIX 1.0 is in early access. Join the waitlist at https://ecodrix.com/#contact and the team reaches out on WhatsApp or email.

**Q: How much does ERIX cost?**
A: Pricing is not published during early access; it is agreed with each pilot business.
